program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((rect (tallest-rect g 0 2))
                  (r1 (nth rect 0))
                  (c1 (nth rect 1))
                  (r2 (nth rect 2))
                  (c2 (nth rect 3)))
             (cellmap g
                      (r c v)
                      (if (and (>= r r1) (<= r r2) (>= c c1) (<= c c2) (zero? v)) 6 v))))))
